description: The government will also establish India’s first public AI university in Bengaluru, with AI certificate courses expected to begin by January 2027.
body_lead: Karnataka CM DK Shivakumar on August 15 announced a series of initiatives aimed at equipping students and young people with artificial intelligence (AI), coding and other skills to compete in the global economy. Speaking on the occasion of India’s 80th Independence Day, Shivakumar said state government will introduce AI education from Class VI onwards in all schools across Karnataka as part of its initiatives for youth and education. The CM announced two major programmes - ‘AI Akshara Abhiyana’ and ‘Coding Gurukul’.
